binding.meaning: Canonicalizes the flat quotient (u+1,v)~(u,-v), (u,v+1)~(u,v), transporting a 0/1 orientation bit by odd horizontal seam crossings. A remainder rounded to exactly one is replaced by the greatest FP32 value below one, as in N1. This is position/orientation transport, not proof of smooth tangent-field covariance.

binding.meaning: Chosen intrinsic field for the Hadamard record: signed distance to a geodesic disk centered at the record anchor in the flat unit Klein quotient, computed as sqrt(dx^2+dy^2)-radius after Nearest_Klein_Lift. Negative is inside. The strict guard 0<radius<0.5 keeps the disk below the quotient injectivity radius; the formula is exact in real arithmetic under this declared metric, with FP32 execution error. It is not ambient 3D distance or N1 radial-offset geometry. The original source does not prescribe this disk field; this is an explicit new binding.
binding.status: Authored intrinsic geodesic-disk SDF binding; CPU/GPU evidence must be recorded separately.

binding.meaning: OLD resident mutator chooses target body from immutable executable bank. Initial version selects its own successor; successor changes hinge and pinion definitions. Hinge selection also reads the prior target body handle through an explicit threshold term; the discrete body-selection law is a declared finite policy.

binding.meaning: For canonical query and anchor coordinates, searches horizontal lifts m=-1,0,1 in that order. x=query_u-anchor_u-m; y=query_v-((-1)^m*anchor_v), followed by y-=floor(y+0.5). Strictly smaller squared distance replaces the preceding candidate, preserving the first minimizer. The vertical +0.5 tie maps to -0.5. anchor_frame_y=(-1)^(abs(m) XOR anchor_orientation)*dy is an explicit frame-coordinate diagnostic; the scalar radial field is independent of that sign. The nearest-lift metric follows N1, while the frame diagnostic is an additional declared binding, not a claim of complete tangent covariance.
binding.status: Explicit finite nearest-lift binding for the unit flat Klein quotient; N1 tie ordering retained.

definition_metadata.meaning: Three-record resident-definition transition component. Old situated mutation and pinion programs determine all targets from one snapshot; rebind uses old field plus new body/anchor and old context; complete new records then act on the wave pair. Every instance has an independent LUT. Initial anchors use the stated31-entry phyllotaxis formula; later anchors are recurrent. Bank selection is finite, immutable program contents; old mutator selects its own successor and acts differently next transaction. State return retains this component only: full31-record/eight-stage source application remains unlowered.
definition_metadata.status: Executable authored binding; hardware evidence pending.

binding_contract.function_bank: Immutable validated expressions; mutable resident handles and values select and parameterize the expressions that execute.
binding_contract.source_identity: Record keys and source indices are checked against the selected source model. Each required source_slots declaration must match the actual body/field/placement JSON tree, ignoring object-key order and preserving scalar types. Numerical function assignments and call plans are explicit authored bindings; this guard is not unrestricted inline source-expression lowering.
binding_contract.mutation_order: Every mutation target reads the same old state and old record table. Candidate records publish together before action. Mutated controller handles govern the next mutation transaction.
binding_contract.source_dependency_evidence: Plan memory/call validity does not prove old-mutator, old-pinion, field-rebinding, or numerical sensitivity obligations. Inspect the authored plan and numerical intervention evidence.
binding_contract.transaction: Any lane failure rolls back all provisional state and record changes and retains failure metadata; successful action commits epoch+1.
binding_contract.instance_semantics: Each lane is an independent substrate instance with its own LUT and state; lanes do not share one operator field.
binding_contract.continuation: DWRD0001 checkpoints include the complete static bank and plans plus every instance state and live record word.
binding_contract.cycle_input: No source cycle file is consumed or implicitly lowered.
not_lowered: automatic lowering of unselected source records

numeric_policy: Finite numeric inputs and constants are packed to IEEE FP32; negative-zero bits are retained. Integer handles, generations and headers remain uint32 words. XIR select is eager.
